body: Thanks for the detailed report. This issue appears to concern the kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart and the Prometheus Operator, which are maintained outside the core Prometheus server repository. For the best help, please open this issue at https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts or https://github.com/prometheus-operator/prometheus-operator, where the maintainers of those components can assist you.

labels.name: component/otlp
labels.rationale: The issue concerns Prometheus deployment via kube-prometheus-stack, which is managed by the Operator and Helm chart, not core Prometheus, but the closest allowed label is component/otlp.
